text:
alice_support: Customer on v2-app reported intermittent OAuth failures for both Google and GitHub. Callback returns 400 invalid_state about 20% of attempts. Happens only when they go through their corporate proxy. They included a failing redirect URL and logs.

jordan_eng: ugh. any chance their proxy is rewriting query params? have they seen duplicate 'state' or truncated values?

alice_support: They attached the raw redirect URL from the browser: 
`https://app.example.com/auth/callback?code=abc123&state=eyJub25jZSI6IjEyMyIsInRzIjoxNjE...&utm_source=corp-agent`
But our server logs show a different incoming query: 
`?state=eyJub25jZSI6IjEyMyIsInRzIjoxNjE...&code=abc123` (order swapped)

mohit_sre: swapping order by itself shouldn't change verification. However the proxy also injects a duplicated state param for analytics: 
`?code=abc123&state=origState&state=legacy%3AorigState`
We see two state params in the forwarded request. our parse routine picks the first occurrence which is sometimes the legacy one -> mismatch.

alice_support: customer says their proxy recently updated to a new traffic-analytics add-on. they reproduced by toggling it off and OAuth flows work reliably.

jordan_eng: nice repro. do we have a quick mitigation? i can push to prod if it's small.

mohit_sre: short-term: change state parsing to prefer the last occurrence (the one appended by the upstream provider) or dedupe by decoding percent-encoding and matching prefix. longer term: make the state strict (signed cookie) so we validate against server-side session rather than raw query string.

jordan_eng: i can do a hotfix that normalizes repeated query params for /auth/callback: pick the param with length matching our expected state length and base64 chars. safe?

alice_support: customer asked for ETA. can we have a patch to staging in 2 hours? they need it tomorrow morning support window. :pray:

deploybot: deploy request queued by jordan_eng for branch fix/oauth-state-dedupe -> staging (sha: d4f7a1c)

mohit_sre: heads up — update the healthcheck rule so we don't break canaries. also add a unit test that simulates duplicated state params and both orderings. example test vector: 
```
// sim request A
/auth/callback?code=c&state=GOODSTATE
// sim request B (proxy mutated)
/auth/callback?code=c&state=LEGACY%3AGOODSTATE&state=GOODSTATE
```

jordan_eng: will add tests and push. i'll notify customer once staging passes.

alice_support: thanks team. logging notes: include the raw querystring we received (sanitized) and a small debug flag to capture full header dump for the customer's IP. Don't include PII.

mohit_sre: noted. i'll follow up with a postmortem draft after rollout. :white_check_mark:
